description: One full-body playable character, transparent background, crisp native pixel art for Dungeon Matcher. Chunky connected forms, near-black #0A0D11 outlines, top-left light, broad matte 2-3 tone material clusters, restrained 14-20 color palette, clean readable small face. Match the supplied Rattlebones rendering discipline, not his species, clothing or colors. No gradients, dithering, glow, subpixel edges, sketchy interior marks or realistic texture. Three-quarter battle stance facing screen RIGHT, feet firmly grounded, complete silhouette and props with breathing room. Redesigned Kobold Gunner: compact rust-red reptilian dungeon scavenger with long readable snout, two pointed ear fins, chunky curled tail for balance, short bent legs, exactly ONE small brass-and-dark-iron revolver in one hand. No hat, cowboy clothing, spurs, cowboy boots, holsters, western poncho, second gun or human face. Crooked linen eye wrap covers one eye; the other eye is a tiny warm amber slit. Cocks his head and cups free hand toward a big ear as if listening for ricochets; mischievous confident expression. Simple dark teal short utility vest, cream neck rag, little cartridge pouch, bare claw feet. Whimsical clever monster, compact 46-50 pixel tall body within 64x64, strong tail and single gun silhouette. Supplied kobold concept is species inspiration ONLY; replace the rejected cowboy outfit, pose and dual guns.
